details:
After loading VRchat, my game will always load fine the first time, but then after the first time whenever I try to change avatar, recalibrate FBT, or change worlds, there's about a 60% chance that it turns me into an error robot. It only turns me into a robot on my end, to others I look fine. I will be unable to change avatars or fix it afterwards too, the only fix is completely rebooting the game.
I have reinstalled vrchat, reinstalled steamVR, completely reinstalled windows on my pc, fresh copy and no saved files. I had someone from my internet company come out and have a look at my system, test all connections, and change the port for the apartment floor that I'm on. I have been in contact with vrchat support who had me test every connection, firewall, and even install something called warp, which did not fix the issue either.
title: Error robot after world load or avatar change
